data.name: AddressBarPlaceholder
data.value: Enter address: example.com, server:8443, or a full URL

data.name: AllowAudioNotificationsToolTip
data.value: Allow Smart Client notification messages to be shown at the top of the current view when this browser instance starts playing audio. These notifications can be used to mute the related browser instance. The web page title will be displayed in the notification to differentiate between multiple browser instances.

data.name: AllowBackgroundBrowserLabel
data.value: Allow browser to run in background

data.name: AllowBackgroundBrowserToolTip
data.value: Leave the browser instance open in the background to improve loading response time. Disabling this will close this browser instance preventing it from using resources in the background.

data.name: ClearBrowsingDataOnExitToolTip
data.value: Clear the browser history, cookies, and all other browsing data when closing Smart Client.

data.name: EnableDevToolsToolTip
data.value: Enable the browser developer tools which can be opened using the F12 keyboard shortcut or the context menu.

data.name: HideAddressToolTip
data.value: Hide the address in the toolbar. Enable this if you want access to the toolbar, but you do not want the user to have access to the address field.

data.name: HideToolbarToolTip
data.value: The toolbar is always visible in setup mode. Enable this to hide the toolbar when not in setup mode. Note that with the toolbar hidden, you will not have access to the address bar, or navigation buttons, and you cannot double-click anywhere to maximize the browser view item.

data.name: InvalidAddressMessage
data.value: "{0}" is not a valid address. Enter a host name (example.com), a host and port (server:8443), or a full http/https URL.

data.name: IsolateBrowserInstancesToolTip
data.value: Use a unique browser profile to isolate this browser instance from any others.

data.name: MissingHomeAddressMessage
data.value: A home address is required. Enter a host name (example.com), a host and port (server:8443), or a full http/https URL.

data.name: MissingNameMessage
data.value: A workspace name is required. Enter a name before saving.

data.name: MuteAudioToolTip
data.value: Mute all audio for this browser instance.

data.name: RememberLastAddressToolTip
data.value: Open this browser instance to the last address instead of the home page.

data.name: WorkspaceConfigErrorNotification
data.value: Web Content workspace "{0}" has a configuration error: {1} Correct the workspace definition in the Management Client.

data.name: WorkspaceConfigErrorMalformedJson
data.value: the saved workspace configuration is corrupt and could not be parsed.

data.name: WorkspaceConfigErrorAdminBanner
data.value: Saved configuration is broken: {0} Press Save to rewrite a clean definition from the values shown.

data.name: WorkspaceConfigErrorMissingBrowserConfig
data.value: no browser page with a home address is configured for this workspace.

data.name: ProxyEnabledLabel
data.value: Route web traffic through the VMS server proxy

data.name: ProxyTargetsHint
data.value: One row per allowlisted target: pick the scheme, enter the host, and add a port only when the target is not on the scheme default. Wildcards: *.foo.bar.com allows that domain's subdomains (never the apex itself), and a lone * allows any host of that scheme except literal IP addresses, localhost and this VMS's own hosts - list those explicitly. Only allowlisted targets can be reached through the proxy.

data.name: ProxyWildcardWarning
data.value: The allowlist contains the full-host wildcard (*): the Event Server will fetch ANY host on that scheme - every host except literal IP addresses, localhost and this VMS's own hosts. Use *.domain.com to bound a wildcard to one domain.

data.name: ProxyRowErrorHostRequired
data.value: A host or wildcard pattern is required.

data.name: ProxyRowErrorPortInvalid
data.value: Port must be a number between 0 and 65535; leave it empty for the scheme default.

data.name: ProxyRowErrorHostInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid host or wildcard pattern.

data.name: InvalidProxyTargetMessage
data.value: {0} is not a valid proxy target. Fix the highlighted row or remove it before saving.

data.name: MissingProxyTargetsMessage
data.value: The proxy is enabled but no target is allowlisted. Add at least one proxy target or disable the proxy.

data.name: ProxyTestFetchHint
data.value: Sends a proxy-fetch request from this Management Client across MIP messaging to the Event Server and reports what came back. Requires the Web Content plugin loaded on the Event Server (restart the Event Server service after deployment).

data.name: ProxyTestFetchNotConnected
data.value: The proxy fetch harness is not connected. Check the Event Server log (MIP.log) and restart the Management Client after a plugin deployment.

data.name: StatusSummaryFormat
data.value: {0} live proxy session(s) - {1:0.0} requests/min, sent {2}/s, received {3}/s

data.name: StatusNoSessions
data.value: No live proxy sessions on this workspace right now. Open a Web Content workspace tab in a Smart Client to see it here.

data.name: StatusNotConnected
data.value: No status from the Event Server: this Management Client has no proxy messaging channel to it. Check the Event Server log (MIP.log) and restart the Management Client after a plugin deployment.

data.name: StatusWorkspaceGone
data.value: The Event Server does not know this workspace any more, so it has no proxy sessions to report.

data.name: StatusNoItemContext
data.value: No workspace item context: this page cannot ask the Event Server for a status snapshot.

data.name: DiagnosticsSummaryFormat
data.value: {0} blocked proxy origin(s) reported for this workspace since the Event Server started tracking. Newest refusal first. The list lives in the Event Server's memory only - it resets when the Event Server service restarts.

data.name: DiagnosticsEmpty
data.value: Nothing has been blocked on this workspace since the Event Server started tracking. As Smart Clients open proxied views and the proxy refuses their requests, every refused origin appears here with its cause and hit count. The list lives in the Event Server's memory only - it resets when the Event Server service restarts.

data.name: DiagnosticsPromotionRefusedFormat
data.value: Could not add '{0}' to the allowlist: it is not an exact proxy origin the allowlist can name.

data.name: BlockedResourcesToolTip
data.value: The proxy refused page resources during this page load. Click to list them.

data.name: ProxyCaExportRunning
data.value: Asking the Event Server for its proxy authority certificate…

data.name: ProxyCaExportNotConnected
data.value: No answer from the Event Server: this Management Client has no proxy messaging channel to it. Check the Event Server log (MIP.log) and restart the Management Client after a plugin deployment.

data.name: ProxyCaExportMissing
data.value: The proxy authority certificate does not exist yet on the Event Server. It is created the first time a proxied HTTPS target is used, or you can provision it once on the Event Server machine - see the plugin README.

data.name: ProxyCaExportSavedFormat
data.value: Saved {0} (thumbprint {1}). Distribute it to Smart Client machines' LocalMachine\Root trusted-root store - the recommended path is Active Directory Group Policy; see the plugin README.
